svg.title: Unified botanical design system — palette and reference synthesis
svg.desc: A visual overview showing how four design references (Kami Parchment, Open Design, Qelora, Claude) merge into one botanical productivity app design system
svg.text: Light mode — the warm paper base
Every reference converges here. Not white, not gray — linen.
Pulled from the references, tuned for botanical.
Flower tab accents — muted, not saturated
Each tab gets one flower color. All stay dusty/earthy.
Qelora's #0e0c0a, but with warm undertone. Not blue-black.
Serif for display headlines (Source Serif Pro from Kami). Sans for UI (Inter Tight from Open Design).
Mono for metadata, timestamps, code (IBM Plex Mono from Kami / JetBrains Mono from Open Design).
